fn count_Substrings(a0: &str) -> i64 {
    let mut count = 0;
    for i in 0..a0.len() {
        for j in i + 1..a0.len() {
            let sum = a0.chars().skip(i).take(j - i).sum::<char>();
            if sum == j as i64 {
                count += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    count
}
